benefit_text: The scheme provides loans up to ₹15,000, ₹25,000 and ₹50,000 repayment periods of 12, 18 and 36 months. Interest subsidy is 7% per annum, credited quarterly. Digital payments earn up to ₹100 cashback monthly. After second loan, a RuPay card with ₹10,000 limit is given.
who_can_apply: Street vendors who have a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body can apply. Vendors identified in the ULB survey but without the certificate, and vendors with a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB or Town Vending Committee are eligible.
documents: Certificate of Vending, Identity Card, Letter of Recommendation, Aadhaar Card, and recent bank account statement.
how_to_apply: Visit the website pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, click Log In, enter mobile number and OTP, provide the survey reference number, select the vendor category, fill the online form, upload required documents and submit the application.
